item.title: Crypto.com: BARA, LION, MTD, CORGIAI, VVS Staking Temporary Service Disruption [investigating]
item.description:
Staking requests for BARA, LION, MTD, and CORGIAI are temporarily unavailable. Staking and unstaking requests for VVS are also temporarily unavailable. Reward distributions for all affected tokens are temporarily paused due to an ongoing Cronos network disruption. Existing staked positions remain unaffected.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and will provide updates as they become available.
